Notes: THE FALLBACK ROW. A competition with no row of its own plays by these, so a season you add tomorrow already works. Class = * means anybody.

Description: Eleven fixtures and a final. Nothing is different.
Notes: THE PLAIN ONE ON PURPOSE. A player has to learn the ordinary game before a competition can bend it, so the first competition bends nothing.

Description: Cold, and nobody is drinking. Brews do not pour and the keeper tires faster.
Notes: WHAT A RULE LOOKS LIKE. No Brews stops the Pub pouring for the whole competition; Tuning is key=value pairs separated by a pipe, and every one of them is an ordinary row of Tuning.csv put back the moment the season ends. tools/season_check.gd names any key that is not.

Description: A closed competition. Two classes only, and nobody above four power.
Notes: ONLY CLASSES is a pipe-separated list, matched loosely. Per Tier overrides the match mode's Squad Per Tier. Between them they are `what is allowed` and `what is on the field`.
